title: Bezier curves by scaffolding
summary:
The red points are connected by a cubic Bezier curve. The blue points are the control points.

Here, the Bezier curve together with its scaffolds is shown. The black points are always the midpoints of their line segment. For test purposes, the canvas renderer is used (instead of SVG).
